[vc_column_text css=””]

Dashboard Audiences

We design dashboards for people. Let’s really understand who they are and what they need to see.

Use of Color

Using case study examples, we’ll go through alert colors (reds, greens), brand colours & themes.

Grid Systems

Designing without a grid system in Power BI is a bad idea. We’ll show off over 70 modern grids.

What is an Insight?

Stop confusing a metric for an insight. Aim for true insights before you start visualizing.

Storytelling with Dashboards

Dashboard Objectives
